title: Ruby Road: our strong cherry ale in a new version
description: Meet the expressive 7% with a fruity cherry, woody, slightly tannic, slightly herbaceous bouquet

blocks.html:
Ruby Road strong cherry ale is a novelty that all style connoisseurs have been waiting for.

This beer is a real find! The expressive, brutal strength of 7% is beautifully combined with a noble, fruity-cherry, woody-barrel, slightly tannic, slightly herbaceous bouquet. Fragrant cherries have a pleasant aroma; a stunning, sparkling cascade of sour-sweet flavors and a long, refined, unique citrus aftertaste.

The formulation used noble, coniferous-fruity, slightly bitter Styrian Bobek hops. As well as malts: traditional light sweet-nut Pilsner, special Belgian dark caramel malt Cara120 and wheat soft Wheat malt, which enriches the bouquet with fruitiness and notes of cereals.

The excellent taste of cherry ale is most fully revealed in combination with dishes such as grilled meat, ham and various soft cheeses.

A great variety for a great mood! Search the store shelves!
